search_mathlib_grep: search Mathlib source code using ripgrep with regex patterns and declaration kind filters
find_mathlib_find_name: find a theorem, lemma, or definition by name in Mathlib with exact or fuzzy matching
read_mathlib_read_file: read a Mathlib Lean source file and optionally return a specific line range
register_mathlib_tools_mixin: register Mathlib search and read tools on an agent via the MathlibToolsMixin class
run_ripgrep_fallback: run ripgrep to search Lean files with a grep fallback when ripgrep is unavailable
